displayDescription: Broad marker strokes build an idea into a connected system, then a red strike-through revises '1 idea' to '5 linked parts!'.
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.1 (local gsap.min.js, single paused timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Marker ink is a procedural approximation: seeded wobbly polylines with per-stroke pressure width, dry-streak knockouts and multiply compositing at per-stroke alpha; no real fluid bleed or paper absorption.
Handwriting uses system fonts (Marker Felt / Chalkboard SE, falling back to Comic Sans MS or cursive) revealed with a left-to-right clip, not traced pen paths.
Fixed overhead framing; the optional crop move after the ink action is omitted so the paper grain stays stationary.
No reviewed preview recipes were listed in STYLE.json and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview demonstrates the style's characteristic action.
Blender was not used. The technology record could not be written because this preview workspace has no project dependency file; only browser Canvas 2D and the host-supplied local GSAP file are used.
